About.Title: About Me
About.Description: I'm Amir, a developer who enjoys turning ideas into things people can actually use. My programming journey started with C# and gradually grew into web development, where I found myself enjoying the process of building interfaces, solving problems, and bringing ideas to life. These days, I'm focused on React, TypeScript, Next.js, and Node.js, while constantly exploring new technologies and improving my skills through real-world projects. For me, coding isn't just about writing code — it's about learning, experimenting, breaking things, fixing them, and building something better every time. Still learning. Still building. Still curious.
